branches.delivery: always admitted by the SET MESSAGES threshold gate
admitted when recipient threshold is High(0) or Medium(10); suppressed for Low(20)
admitted only when recipient threshold is High(0)

player_visible_help.summary: SET MESSAGES LOW receives high-priority room messages only; MEDIUM receives high+medium; HIGH receives high+medium+low.
player_visible_help.release_note_corroboration: Version 0.4p explicitly identifies room pickup/drop messages as low priority.

high_priority_examples: room SAY/YELL and communication-visible room speech
door/open/close/bash/search/disarm and other important room actions
GIVE and gang-shop stock/unstock observer events

callsite_census.dynamic_note: Dynamic movement/drag/autocombat paths preserve caller-owned semantics; Reforged's still-unclosed DRAG/autocombat timing remains tracked by their own assertions rather than being invented here.

reforged_integration.recipient_side_filter: RuntimeSessionManager.BroadcastRoom loads each persistent recipient's saved Classic messages level and applies the recovered threshold before enqueue.
reforged_integration.high_default: Existing room broadcasts remain HIGH unless an evidence-backed Medium/Low owner explicitly supplies a priority.
low_integrations: normal visible item GET observer message
medium_integrations: decoded player spell start observer message
reforged_integration.mega_mud: MegaMUD remains on the ordinary terminal stream and sees the threshold-filtered stream exactly as another connected MajorMUD client would.
reforged_integration.borin: Borin must not override the player's SET MESSAGES choice and must use authoritative/private state channels rather than relying on ambient observer chatter that may be intentionally suppressed.

parity_promotion.reason: After Worldgroup-only host plumbing was removed from parity scope in 0348, exact SET MESSAGES recipient threshold semantics were the remaining player-visible blocker. 0349 recovers the numeric gate and integrates evidence-backed room-message priority classes in the server stream.
